title: Mediterranean Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with tender chicken, crunchy veggies, and creamy tzatziki sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and your favorite herbs.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
Meanwhile, toast the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the tzatziki sauce on the wrap, then adding the sliced chicken, cucumber, tomato, red onion, and feta cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately.
